title: Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: Eggs baked in a spiced tomato and feta sauce
excerpt: Eggs baked directly in a thick, spiced tomato sauce with crumbled feta on top. One pan, 25 minutes in the oven, and it feeds four with bread alongside.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from shakshuka and Middle Eastern baked egg traditions. The combination of tinned and fresh tomatoes gives both depth and brightness.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The tomato sauce can be made up to 2 days ahead and kept in the fridge. Reheat the sauce before adding the eggs.

content.text: Use an oven-safe frying pan so you can go straight from the hob to the oven without transferring the sauce.
Heat the oven to 200C. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe frying pan over medium heat. Fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, and chilli flakes. Cook for 1 minute. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until they begin to soften.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes. Season well. Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Make 8 wells in the sauce with the back of a spoon. Crack one egg into each well.
Scatter the crumbled feta over the sauce around the eggs.
Transfer the pan to the oven. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Scatter basil leaves over the top. Serve straight from the pan with bread.

items.symptom: Yolks are hard when you wanted them runny.
items.cause: Left in the oven too long.
items.fix: Check at 8 minutes; the yolks will firm up quickly after that.

items.symptom: Whites are not fully set around the edges.
items.cause: Sauce was too cold when eggs went in.
items.fix: Make sure the sauce is at a full simmer before adding eggs.

items.cause: Not simmered long enough before the eggs were added.
items.fix: Simmer the sauce for at least 8 minutes on the hob first.
